subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should approved custom widgets gain durable `state:persist` authority through parent-mediated Workspaces gateway RPCs, including automatic state deletion when widget identity or kind changes?
rationale: The implementation is additive and mechanically guarded, but it permanently expands what untrusted agent-authored widget code may cause the trusted parent to persist and creates a durable capability contract that code review alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve After Proof
options.body: Accept the scoped parent-bound contract after current-head browser and upgrade evidence confirms persistence, conflict handling, and lifecycle deletion.

options.title: Keep Widgets Stateless
options.body: Decline the new capability and keep custom widgets read-only until maintainers choose a narrower persistence model.

recommendation.title: Approve After Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the scoped parent-bound contract after current-head browser and upgrade evidence confirms persistence, conflict handling, and lifecycle deletion.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Workspaces foundation established the affected plugin, persistence, gateway, and sandbox boundaries.
